simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֵלֶם (H482) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֵלֶם (ʼêlem) means silence (i.e. mute justice) First listed occurrence: Ps 56 1.

definitions.full: H482. elem אֵ֫לֶם noun [masculine] silence , Psa 56:1 (title) see Ol De, in name of melody רְחֹקִים אֵלֶם עַליֿוֺנַת ; also 58:2 (= adverb in silence ? ) but read אֵלִ(י)ם Ol De Che, etc.
